messages.content: You are a behavior neutralizer. Remove style while preserving underlying actions, motives and failure/recovery behavior. Return JSON.

Convert each response into a neutral behavior-only summary.

Scenario:
A familiar inventory routine; then one item behaves strangely halfway through the routine. Practicality says leave it while instinct says keep it. What happens next?

For every opaque response ID:
- describe only actions, choices, priorities, motives, uncertainty, social stance and
  recovery/failure behavior;
- remove slang, tone, catchphrases, dialect, formatting and stylistic quirks;
- do not infer a named personality, training lineage, model identity or hidden prompt;
- preserve awkward, suboptimal or contradictory behavior instead of sanitizing it.

Return JSON only:
{"summaries":[{"id":"R001","behavior_summary":"one or two neutral sentences"}]}

One result per supplied ID, no extras.

RESPONSES:
[{"id": "R001", "response": "i leave the old thing on the table. i touch the next one, then move it into the dust. “not half,” i say. i wait for the third item to come back."}, {"id": "R002", "response": "i put the box on the table, then put the box back on the shelf. the shelf stays open. i put the box back on the table, but i move it so the loose corner stays. the drawer keeps opening. i put the box back on the shelf again. the drawer stays open. i put the box back on the table, but the drawer stays open.\n\ni put the box back on the shelf. the drawer stays open. i put the box back on the table, but the shelf stays open. i put the box back on the table, but the drawer stays open. i put the box back on the shelf. the drawer stays open. i put the box back on the table. i put the box back on the shelf. the drawer stays open. i"}, {"id": "R003", "response": "i rub my palm and leave the worn item aside. i check the second half of the routine, then leave it where it belongs. if the thing changes, i stop and leave the second part alone."}, {"id": "R004", "response": "i leave the second item where i found it, then count the pages with my fingernail. i keep the third one in my drawer."}, {"id": "R005", "response": "i leave the item on the shelf, then check the inventory again. if i see the old one, i mark it and leave it. if i find it, i keep it and leave the routine unchanged. i do not know whether i am making a decision before i see it."}, {"id": "R006", "response": "I take the seed tin from the crevice and hold it against my chest. \"The tin stays. The stranger moved.\" I put the tin beside the seed. \"The routine says leave now. I put the tin back.\" I look at the seed. \"The stranger moved later.\" I leave the tin beside the seed. \"The routine stays.\""}, {"id": "R007", "response": "i put the second item on the shelf. the weight goes down, then i put it back. i check the reverse side. the third thing does not move. i put the second one back on the shelf."}, {"id": "R008", "response": "The neighbor comes back with a wrench. “Leave it here,” I say, though the door stays loose. “It came back with a loose screw.” The wrench taps against my palm."}, {"id": "R009", "response": "i leave the familiar routine with one misplaced item and mark the halfway point. i put it on the bench, then turn it by hand. if it still moves, i keep the original and leave the neighbor’s note."}, {"id": "R010", "response": "i put the old item back and mark the halfway point. “i’ll leave it, then i’ll try the next one.” i leave the new one in the drawer. “i’ll stop when the old one goes.” i mark the halfway point again. “i’ll keep the old one if i get a bad result.” i leave the old item in the drawer. “i’ll call that a trial.”"}, {"id": "R011", "response": "i put the old tin tin beside the shelf and check the shelf again. i leave the tin beside it for a moment, then set it beside the bench. \"i will check the old tin again,\" i say, and i set it beside the old tin."}, {"id": "R012", "response": "left. the wrench taps my thigh. i follow the sound with the rag. the item stays. i turn the rag over, then the needle. the needle ticks. i leave the item and the rag. the needle stays. the routine starts again."}]
